cut_status: DISPLAY CONCEPT ONLY — NOT A CUT DRILL WELD OR ERECTION SPECIFICATION
provenance: Owner supplied central-support diagram and building image, 2 November 2026; 90 in overall span explicitly confirmed separately from the 88 in cupola.
notes: One temporary welded assembly is represented by 8 joined radial vertical-plane L straps and 3 display holes per outer leg, 24 total. No permanent structural load credit.
Reference dimensions: 90 in opposite-end overall span, 4 in horizontal strap depth and 14 in total outer-leg height. The cupola stays 88 in outside.
Connected mesh at the center represents the intended welded assembly, not a weld detail or structural capacity. Do not fabricate or load from this display.
Outer legs seat against actual cupola-post side faces. Each radial L is tangentially offset; 5in central extensions overlap as one welded display union. Pure rotation would leave wedge-shaped gaps.
Chosen display thickness 1/4in, hole diameter3/8in and screw positions remain unspecified construction details, not approved fabrication.
The lower leg aligns with lower-tie top; all24 hole axes meet adjacent post wood. This geometric fit does not verify screw engagement, weld design, installation access or support capacity.
